key_mechanism: Short strike is being approached; near-strike gamma risk rises and IV expansion inflates spread value.
Defined-risk constraint suggests reducing risk or rolling to re-establish distance.

options.name: Reduce risk / partial close
mechanics: Close 50–100% of the spread to cap further loss.
triggers: If spot trades below a defined support level.
If spread hits pre-set loss multiple.
max_risk_notes: Do not exceed max daily loss limit.
Use limit orders if bid/ask widens.

risk_guardrails: If catalyst risk is near (CPI), prioritize defense over repair.
Do not increase max loss beyond the original defined-risk width.
If missing greeks/marks, default to reducing exposure.
